Subject: EB briefing play & sponsor roll-call — MAP + eval timeline

Hi Kelly —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short evaluation timeline so your execs and procurement team can see the milestones we expect leading into a potential Q3 go-live. Key asks in this note:

- Please confirm who from Acme will be the executive sponsor(s) for the EB briefing (name + title). We typically ask for a single executive sponsor + product/ops lead.
- Confirm preferred windows for a 30–45m EB briefing in the two weeks starting Apr 19. We can host in PT/ET.
- If procurement needs SOC2 or data-retention language up front, loop in procurement@acmecorp.com and we'll surface the artifacts.

Attached: 20270410-Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone owners) and 20270410-Acme-eval-plan.docx (evaluation checklist / success criteria).

Proposed quick timeline (high level):
- Apr 19–30: EB briefing + PROD POC kickoff
- May 3–21: POC / eval window (per our suggested metrics)
- Jun 1: pricing / contract review

I copied Priya to help coordinate the EB roster and any compliance artifacts.

Thanks,
Rohan

Team —

Thread from Acme below. Kelly (SVP Product) will be the executive sponsor and expects the CTO to join; procurement asked for SOC2 summary + sample DPA. Two asks for us before we lock the EB:

1) Sponsor roll-call: Marissa, can you draft the one-slide sponsor roster (who from Redwood should speak to business outcomes, reliability/SLA, and security/compliance) and highlight who will attend the EB? Suggest:
   - Exec sponsor intro: Rohan (deal owner) + Kelly (Acme)
   - Reliability & performance: Vivek Kulkarni (platform/RIs)
   - Security & compliance: Priya Natarajan (security/compliance)
   - Commercial/terms: Marissa Cole (pricing/finance lead)

2) MAP tweaks: Kelly will want a tight EB agenda and to see owners aligned to each milestone. I attached a MAP and eval plan (same as sent). Priya — can you pre-stage the SOC2 type II summary and the DPA template so we can hand them to procurement at the EB?

Timing: Acme prefers Apr 20 10–11 PT or Apr 21 after 1pm PT. My preference is Apr 20 10:00 PT (30–40m). Can everyone confirm availability by EOD Tue (Apr 13) so I can send the invite.

Notes for the EB agenda (draft):
- 5m: Introductions & success metrics (Rohan + Kelly)
- 10m: Redwood runtime overview + key perf profile (Vivek)
- 10m: Security/compliance & data handling (Priya)
- 5m: POC approach, acceptance criteria, timeline (Rohan/Marissa)
- 5–10m: Q&A / next steps

Thanks — please keep replies short (thumbs-up ok).

Rohan
